@@ -0,0 +1,39 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M1H2T6A20GC8GPZ8SKYK3FXB
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8580'
+title: 'Ask 4b: deliver a call''s attachments live as SessionEvent.toolCallReport when the call closes'
+---
+## What
+Router half of Ask 4, step two. Carry the attachments a call collected (task 4a) on the live event surface, keyed by the same `correlationID` the call's `ToolInvocationRecord` carries, so the ACP agent can fill `tool_call_update.locations` without reading the model-facing output.
+
+Files:
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Session/SessionEvent.swift`: add `public struct ToolCallReport: Sendable, Equatable { tool, op, correlationID, sessionID, attachments: [ToolCallAttachment] }` and `case toolCallReport(ToolCallReport)`. Doc: delivery-only, never recorded; emitted once per call, after the close `toolInvocation` record, only when the call attached at least one record; `correlationID` is the run's `completionToken`, the same value as the call's `ToolInvocationRecord.correlationID`, never a `Transcript.ToolCall.id`. Travels on `streamSessionEvents()` always and on the turn's stream when the call closes inside a turn.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Session/OperationEventJournal.swift`: add `func deliver(report: ToolCallReport) async` to `ToolInvocationObserver`.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Session/SessionOutbox.swift`: add `func post(report: ToolCallReport) async` that forwards to `invocationObserver?.deliver(report:)`, beside `post(invocation:)`. Not staged, not journaled.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Session/RoutedSessionActorRunJournal.swift`: implement `deliver(report:)` as `deliverLive(.toolCallReport(report))`.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Hosting/ToolRun.swift` (`execute`) and `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Hosting/ContextBindingTool.swift` (`bind`): after the close invocation record posts, when the drained attachments are not empty, build a `ToolCallReport` from the context's stamps and post it through `sink.post(report:)`. `OperationEventSink` is an Extras protocol, so add `post(invocation:)`-style routing the same way that method reaches `SessionOutbox` today (follow the existing pattern; a sink that is not the outbox drops the report).
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Session/SessionProjection.swift`: add `.toolCallReport` to the no-op arm.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Session/RoutedSession.swift`: list the new case in the `streamSessionEvents()` doc.
+
+This card touches six files. Keep each edit small; the projection and doc edits are one line each.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A run-to-completion tool that attaches one record produces, in order on the turn's stream: open `toolInvocation`, close `toolInvocation`, then one `toolCallReport` with the same `correlationID` and the attachment.
+- [ ] A background tool that attaches produces the `toolCallReport` on `streamSessionEvents()` when the run settles, after the close record.
+- [ ] A `ContextBindingTool` call (non-`String` output) that attaches produces the report the same way.
+- [ ] A call that attaches nothing produces no `toolCallReport`.
+- [ ] The report never appears in the recorded transcript (`InMemoryRecorder` holds no event for it).
+- [ ] `SessionProjection.apply(.toolCallReport)` changes no state.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/ToolInvocationLivenessTests.swift`: three tests for the three decorators, each asserting event order and `correlationID` equality with the close record.
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/ToolInvocationLivenessTests.swift`: no report for a call with no attachments; recorder holds no report.
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/SessionProjectionTests.swift`: `apply(.toolCallReport(...))` is a no-op.
+- [ ] Run `swift build 2>&1` and `swift test`. Expect zero warnings and all green.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd`: write the failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
